capabilities: Navigate headings via outline tree, sibling/part jumps, and commands
Auto-scroll continuously with adjustable speed synced across panels
Track and restore last reading position across edit/reading modes
Display reading progress bar and active section indicator
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; beta releases available via BRAT.
intentEvidence: a highly polished document outline and navigation plugin for Obsidian
problem: Obsidian's default outline and navigation handle bidirectional (Persian/Arabic mixed RTL/LTR) headings poorly and offer no auto-scroll or cross-view position memory.

relations.evidence: Install the Obsidian42 - BRAT community plugin.

summary: RTL-aware heading outline navigator with scroll-spy, section jumps, auto-scroll, reading progress, and per-note position memory.
